purpose: Registry of approved research topics that the local Research Agent memo runner may use.
rules: Research topics are read-only inputs for memo generation.
A topic may propose code, evals, prompts or schema work, but must not apply changes directly.
Every topic must declare priority, risk, expected memo output and allowed next step.
Every topic must map back to a measurable PILAR product problem.

topics.title: AI agents for web and product testing
topics.problem_mapping: PILAR needs reliable regression coverage across input, run creation, result page, full report, PDF/Word downloads and known forbidden strings.
expected_outputs: MVP scope for Synthetic User Agent
topics.allowed_next_step: Suggest-only memo. No direct app-code changes.

topics.title: Agent observability and trace analytics
topics.problem_mapping: PILAR needs visibility into run quality, agent disagreement, silent failures, i18n drift and report rendering failures.
topics.allowed_next_step: Research memo and schema proposal only.

topics.title: Runtime guardrails for agent actions and engineering claims
topics.problem_mapping: PILAR must prevent unsupported final approval, invented code values, mixed standards and overconfident engineering claims.
blocked_actions: blocking live user output without runtime testing

topics.title: Report QA Agent for calculation notes and exports
topics.problem_mapping: PILAR reports must be checked for assumptions, units, conclusion strength, language shell consistency and PDF/Word parity.
